mapper.insert: insert into flow_threshold(scenic_id, threshold_type, area_code, value, enabled) values(#{scenicId}, #{thresholdType}, #{areaCode}, #{value}, #{enabled})
mapper.select: select * from flow_threshold where id=#{id} limit 1
select * from flow_threshold where scenic_id=#{scenicId} order by id asc
select * from flow_threshold where scenic_id=#{scenicId} and enabled=1
